one_liner: MrScraper has a REST scraping API with self-serve API tokens, a reported free tier, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API uses an API token sent in the x-api-token header. Marketplace endpoints take the same token as a Bearer token. OAuth 2.1 exists only on the hosted MCP server, not on the REST API, so it is not listed as an API auth method.
access_notes: The free plan is reported to need no credit card and to include API tokens. The pricing page was not in the pages re-checked, so the free allocation could not be re-verified. Sources disagreed earlier: 1,000 tokens per month in one place, 100 in the billing docs. API keys are created in the dashboard at app.mrscraper.com/api-tokens.
blocker_notes: None found. The breadth rating is a judgement because no endpoint count was given. The free-tier claim rests on pages not re-fetched here.

evidence.quote: Include your API token in the `x-api-token` HTTP header on every request
API tokens are managed directly from your MrScraper dashboard.
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.
Obtain an API key from [the MrScraper app](https://app.mrscraper.com/api-tokens).
The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints.
MrScraper MCP is the official Model Context Protocol server for MrScraper.
Use the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint for a managed connection
